notes.title: Update Notice: Reinstallation Required for English ver. Launch Issues
notes.content:
[p]Alongside Chinese localization deployment in Build 16898375, this update includes [b]fixes for known English version bugs[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]If your game fails to launch after update (Build 16898375):[/b]
This may be caused by legacy official patches. Perform these steps:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Completely uninstall all game components[/b]
→ Delete game folders including supplemental content patches[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clean reinstall via Steam[/b]
→ Reinstall base game through Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p][b]Acquire updated content[/b]
→ Obtain latest compatible patches through official distribution channels[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884169/7a462c5cae7b01ce5377d41212d697674d705648.gif"][/img][/p]

tags.bug: fixes for known English version bugs
